prd_template:
# PRD: <feature>
## Problem, users and goals
## Scope and non-goals
## User flows and required behavior
## Constraints and dependencies
## Vertical slices and observable acceptance criteria
## Edge cases and failure behavior
## Assumptions, open questions and deferred decisions
Use only applicable sections; combine short sections. Reference decision IDs. Do not add architecture or product decisions. Proposed slices remain proposals, not approved requirements.
